# Working of the Program

#### Course: Learn Recursion With C++

## Working of the Program

![Each Recursive Call Returns a Different Value](data:image/png;base64,)

When the base condition is reached, the final function returns "Done".

As this value propagates back through the chain of recursive calls, the string " over" is repeatedly concatenated to the previous return value.

This results in the function returning "Done", then "Done over", then finally "Done over over", which is shown by the table below:

| Value of n | Return Value |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | "Done" |
| 2 | "Done over" |
| 1 | "Done over over" |
